Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane of a roadway in League City, Texas, when Driver 2 changed laens into the same
space and the two vehicles sideswiped one another. Driver 1 reported a concussion following the impact and was
evaluated at the scene. The injury described is consistent with the type and force of the collision observed. Vehicle
damage on both cars lines up with the contact points and direction of travel that the drivers described. Two
indepenednt witnesses, Driver 2, and photographs taken at the scene all confirm that the collision occurred as Driver
1 described. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known to the responding officer or reported by anyone at the
scene. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. Driver 1 was the only occupant of
the vehicle at the time of impact, though the Passenger seat position relative to where Driver 1 was seated could not
be fully clarified during the interview. The responding officer documented the scene and issued citations as
appropriate.
